title: Six Fintech Screens with Control Headline
whatItIs: A pale page with a Financial Control pill, a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif 'Every Detail.', a paragraph, four tag pills and six phones in two rows: wallet, cards, card details sheet, profile, QR scan and payment successful, all in blue-grey gradients.
whatItMeans: A consistent gradient rising in each screen and shared bezels give six functions one calm voice.
techniques: Blue-grey gradient rising from each screen base
Bottom sheets rising over blurred screens
Staggered layout of phones in two rows

vocabulary.definition: A panel rising from the bottom over a dimmed screen.
A bar filled with fine diagonal lines.
